_comment: Terms used or chosen for the lesson what-is-communication. status: ok = attested in a Turkish source I opened (TDK Güncel Türkçe Sözlük, TÜBİTAK Sosyal Bilimler Ansiklopedisi 'İletişim' by Yusuf Adıgüzel, 2022); chosen = my own choice among plausible renderings; check = weakly attested or translated by me, needs a Turkish-language reviewer.

communication.note: TDK (iletişim: meaning 1 and 2) lists bildirişim, haberleşme, komünikasyon, and muhabere for meaning 2; TÜBİTAK entry lists haberleşme, bildirişim, komünikasyon, muhabere. TDK: komünikasyon = French 'communication'.

intrapersonal-communication.note: TÜBİTAK uses 'iç iletişim'. 'Kişi içi' is my preferred rendering (parallel with 'kişilerarası'); not confirmed in a source I opened.

interpersonal-communication.note: TÜBİTAK uses 'bireyler arası iletişim'. 'Kişilerarası' is the common one-word form in Turkish writing but I did not confirm it in a source I opened.

mass-communication.note: TÜBİTAK: 'kitle iletişimi'. The course title 'Kitle İletişim Kuramları' uses the same stem.

message.note: TÜBİTAK uses 'ileti'; 'mesaj' is the everyday synonym and is used in prose.

receiver.note: TÜBİTAK: 'hedef / hedef kitle'. 'Alıcı' is the usual counterpart of 'kaynak/gönderici' in prose.

code.note: TÜBİTAK element list ('kod'). Encoding/decoding rendered 'kodlama' / 'kod açma'.

transmission-view.note: My translation of Carey's 'transmission view'; no Turkish source opened. The course title for the later lesson uses 'ritüel görüşü'.

ritual-view.note: Title of the planned lesson 'İletişimin Ritüel Görüşü: Carey' in course.json (project owner's list).

nonverbal-communication.note: Both 'sözsüz' and 'sözel olmayan' are common in Turkish writing; neither confirmed in a source I opened. 'Beden dili' is used only as a popular label.

kinesics.note: Loan form; no Turkish source opened.

axiom.note: Standard Turkish loan; Turkish writing on Watzlawick may also say 'temel önerme' or 'varsayım' (not confirmed).

metacommunication.note: My choice; the prefix 'üst-' parallels 'üstdil'. Not confirmed in a Turkish communication source.

punctuation.note: My literal rendering of Watzlawick et al.'s 'punctuation'.

digital-analogic.note: 'Digital' in the axiom means discrete, defined elements (mostly words); 'analogic' means communication by resemblance (gesture, tone). Turkish rendering is mine.

symmetrical-complementary.note: My rendering of the fifth axiom's pair.

conduit-metaphor.note: Reddy's 'conduit metaphor'; the Turkish rendering is mine. To be kept apart from 'kanal' as channel in the process model.

mass-self-communication.note: Castells's term; Turkish rendering is mine.

masspersonal-communication.note: O'Sullivan & Carr's term; Turkish rendering is mine (an alternative would be 'kitle-kişilerarası iletişim').

dispersed-audience.note: Maletzke's 'disperses Publikum'; Turkish rendering is mine.

para-feedback.note: Term reported by Ioni & Pstae 2017 for Maletzke; the Turkish rendering is mine and is used sparingly in the lesson (the card speaks of 'zayıf geri bildirim').
